title: I Described an App. AI Built It.
script: I described an app for thirty seconds. Then I handed the transcript to AI. Three columns: To do, Doing, Done. Drag the cards. Keep them after a refresh. Here is what it built on the first pass. I moved a card, refreshed the page, and checked whether the board remembered. [DRAG_AND_PERSISTENCE_RESULT]. It needed [CORRECTION_COUNT] corrections. What useful app should I describe next?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: A voice specification becomes a local Kanban board with drag/drop and persistence.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: I described an app for thirty seconds. Then I handed the transcript to AI.
Can a spoken idea survive the refresh test?
I wanted three columns, not a complicated app.
strongestHook: I described an app for thirty seconds. Then I handed the transcript to AI.
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: A voice specification becomes a local Kanban board with drag/drop and persistence. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 15–60 minutes core build/test; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Record a genuine roughly 30-second specification when voice work resumes; for now feed this exact text: Build a local Kanban board with To do, Doing and Done columns. Add and delete cards, drag cards between columns, and persist the board in local storage after refresh. No backend. Save first pass. Acceptance: add card, edit/delete if implemented as requested, drag in both directions, refresh persistence, empty state, no console error. Record corrections and verified completion time.
evidenceRequirements: Record the voice specification, transcript, build and functional checks.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “Voice Into Kanban” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
ending: What useful app should I describe next?
instagramCaption: I Described an App. AI Built It.. A voice specification becomes a local Kanban board with drag/drop and persistence. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. What useful app should I describe next?
tiktokCaption: I Described an App. AI Built It.. WHAT SHOULD I BUILD?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
assetBrief: Waveform, transcript, agent run, final Kanban.
